title: Processing Murine Tissues into Sections
author: Bianca Hemmeryckx
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.katcsen

steps.title: Fix Tissues
steps.instruction: Fix tissues in embedding cassettes for 24 hours using 4% formaldehyde.

steps.title: Wash Tissues
steps.instruction: Wash tissues 3 times for 15 minutes each with 1x phosphate buffered saline (PBS).

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10x PBS: combine 80g NaCl, 2g KCl, 14.4g Na2HPO4, and 2.4g KH2PO4; adjust to pH 7.4 and bring to 1L with MilliQ water.
Prepare 1x PBS: dilute 100 ml 10x PBS with 900 ml denatured water (AD).

steps.title: Initial Ethanol Storage
steps.instruction: Place cassettes in 70% ethanol and store at +4°C until further processing.

steps.title: Embed Tissues
steps.instruction: Embed paraffin-embedded tissues on cassettes using metal molds with the Leica EG 1150 H & C Embedding Center.

steps.title: Cut Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Cut 8 µm tissue sections using the HM366S microtome (Thermo Fisher Scientific) onto albumin-coated Superfrost Plus glass slides.

substeps.instruction: Use egg albumin in 50% glycerol (VWR International (Avantor) Catalog #641183) for coating.
